summary: Iteration 6 — TGC Prestige Pi-Economy + P0 Mining Kill/Resume crash fix tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_tgc.py with 12 tests across 6 classes covering all new endpoints; ALL 12 PASSED. Full regression of prior iters: 112 passed, 2 failed (both stale tests obsolete by design change), 1 skipped. Frontend Playwright runs verified: admin-tab-mining loads MiningOrchestrator without React crash; Kill Switch + Resume buttons clickable and do NOT crash the page (P0 fix confirmed); Admin Shield panel saves difficulty_factor (×1.50 reflected in shield-factor-value); Dashboard shows TGC stat cards + 200 TGC / $10 threshold; /mobile (420×900) shows TGC counter, Power-Up card (active after click), Tier Forecast card with all sub-elements (tier-detected-label, tier-daily-tgc, tier-daily-usdt). Worker login redirects to /dashboard; admin login redirects to /admin.

minor.issue: current_margin observed at 28.6% in live admin view (below profit_floor 30%) due to existing TGC accrual in DB; expected — admin needs to bump difficulty_factor. Not a bug, but UI does not surface a warning when margin < floor.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking kill-switch-btn, no element with data-testid='kill-status' was found in DOM (orchestrator still alive, no crash, but the kill-status banner described in the request is either named differently or only appears under a specific state). The P0 'no-crash' guarantee is fully met; only the banner testid contract is unverified.

action_items: (Optional) Verify the `kill-status` banner data-testid in MiningOrchestrator.jsx — current Playwright run could not locate it after kill click. Page does not crash; this is a contract/visibility concern only.

(Stale test) /app/backend/tests/test_grid_backend.py::TestWallet::test_wallet_structure asserts withdraw_threshold==5.0 (legacy USDT). Per spec the field is now 200 TGC. Update the test or expose `withdraw_threshold_usdt` separately — already present in /api/wallet response but the legacy `withdraw_threshold` key was repurposed.

(Stale/flaky) /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_mining.py::TestHeartbeatHashrate::test_heartbeat_accepts_and_persists — device not found in /admin/mining/stats devices list (timing or eviction). Likely flaky; investigate.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/wallet's `withdraw_threshold` key was overloaded from USDT(5) to TGC(200) instead of being renamed. Existing clients/tests reading `withdraw_threshold` will silently break. Recommend renaming and keeping a deprecated alias for one cycle.

TGC drip in /api/tasks/submit silently rounds tgc_earned to 6dp; for 250ms compute on flagship the per-task drip ≈ (6/86400)*0.25 ≈ 0.0000174 → rounds to 0.000017. After many tasks balance grows but a single-task assert can see 0. Tests should rely on aggregate, not per-task.

/api/admin/shield computes current_margin from cumulative tgc_total_earned vs implied 7:5 real-mined — but tgc_total_earned counts ALL users (incl. admin). If admin ever earns TGC, the margin calc becomes self-referential. Filter by role!=admin in the aggregation.
POST /api/admin/shield accepts `payload: dict` rather than a Pydantic model; no validation beyond the [0.5,50] range. Use a Pydantic BaseModel with Field(ge=0.5, le=50).
server.py is now ~1546 lines. Splitting into modules (auth, wallet, tier, shield, mining, jobs, admin, ws) is overdue.

_is_powered_up + _power_up_remaining_seconds parse ISO datetimes; if power_up_at is stored as a Mongo Date instead of an ISO string in some path, the silent except returns False/0 (already done). Consider normalising on write.
Frontend `kill-status` banner contract — if the banner is intended as a persistent UI signal post-kill, ensure it's rendered (not gated on a transient state) and exposes data-testid='kill-status'.
